personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, highly readable, and clear financial utility that feels native, calm, and effortlessly responsive.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edge (use lg outer padding). Maintain thumb zone by keeping CTA buttons sticky at bottom.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Sticky headers over scrolling content (like filters in History)
Hero card overlay (frosted glass sitting on the green abstract photo backdrop)

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry and registration into the tracker.

states.error: Readable message + Retry button above inputs

screens.layout: Minimalist plant background image (auth_bg) filling top half with a gradient scrim fading to bottom. Form container (surfaceSecondary) anchored at bottom with lg padding. Brand logo at top left. Email/password fields with label above, and full-width brandPrimary sticky button at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Immediate overview of today's spending, budget status, and recent transactions.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for hero card and lists
states.empty: Empty state illustration (empty_state) + 'No expenses today' + 'Add your first expense' CTA
states.error: Full screen error state + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Lead with a 'Hero' spending card using the abstract green image (hero_card_bg) layered with a vertical dark scrim (Layer 0: image, Layer 1: linear gradient 0% to 70% surfaceInverse, Layer 2: Oversized display typography for balance, budget status badge). Below hero, show a compact 'charts before numbers' Weekly Summary Donut Chart. Follow with Recent Expenses list grouped by date (Today, Yesterday) using brandTertiary rounded icon containers for categories. Include a Floating Action Button (FAB) for 'Add Expense' above the glass bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Add Expense (Sheet)
screens.purpose: Frictionless and immediate entry of a new transaction.

states.loading: Spinner on the Save button during submit
states.error: Inline text error below specific failed field

screens.layout: Presented as a bottom sheet. Oversized 'Space Grotesk' keypad-driven or text input for the amount at the top, centered. Below it, an 8-tile Category icon grid (no dropdowns, immediate tap selection). Fields for Notes and Date Picker below. A sticky 'Save Transaction' primary button anchored at the bottom edge above the keyboard.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Searchable archive of all spending with easy filtering.

states.empty: Icon + 'No expenses match your filters' + 'Clear filters' CTA

screens.layout: Glassmorphic sticky header containing horizontal scrolling filter chips (All, This Week, Month, Income, Expense). Main content is a continuous scrolling list of transactions grouped by date headers. Each list row is a minimum 56pt height with a category icon, title, date, and right-aligned amount.

screens.name: Statistics
screens.purpose: Detailed visual analysis of spending habits across timeframes.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Not enough data to show charts' + 'Log an expense' CTA

screens.layout: Sticky header with a Week/Month/Year segmented control. Top half contains a large Donut Chart (Victory Native/Gifted Charts) showing category splits. Bottom half lists the categories sorted by highest spend to lowest, with amount and percentage bars.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configuration, profile management, and app preferences.

states.error: Toast or inline error for failed updates

screens.layout: Standard iOS-native settings layout. Scrollable list grouped by sections (Profile, Preferences, Security, Admin). Use surfaceSecondary cards for groups, divider tokens between rows. Each row has a leading icon in a brandTertiary container, label, and trailing chevron.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Centralized management of users, global categories, and platform expenses.
screens.layout: Utility-first dashboard layout. Top summary cards showing total users, total expenses, active categories. Tabbed or segmented view below to switch between Users, Expenses, and Categories management lists.

hero_card_bg.alt: Abstract layers of smooth dark green geometric texture

empty_state.alt: Flat lay of notebooks and stationery on a clean background

auth_bg.alt: Green leafed plant on clear glass vase, clean minimalist aesthetic

instructions_to_main_agent: PREMIUM REQUIREMENT: Use 'Space Grotesk' for display/numbers (amounts, balances, large keypad text) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text, labels, and body UI. This font pairing is essential for the finance vibe.
NO-TOLERANCE COLOR RULE: Absolutely no blues, purples, indigos, or oranges. Strict adherence to the provided Botanical/Emerald palette.

HERO CARD SCRIM: The Dashboard Hero card MUST stack 3 layers: Layer 0 (hero_card_bg image), Layer 1 (Vertical gradient scrim fading from 0% at top to 70%+ surfaceInverse at bottom), Layer 2 (Text/content). Never place text directly on the image without this scrim.
IMAGE PREFERENCE: Use the provided `empty_state` real image for empty states instead of basic system icons. It drastically elevates the production feel.
ADD EXPENSE FLOW: Implement Add Expense as a bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet). Feature an oversized amount input at the top and an 8-tile icon category grid below it (no dropdowns).
LAYOUT FINDING: Based on web research, prioritize 'charts before numbers'—place a quick visual donut chart summary immediately after the hero card on the dashboard.
Ensure max 2 glass surfaces per screen (e.g., sticky header and bottom tab bar). Apply glass to the FAB.
All data screens must explicitly implement the Loading, Empty, and Error states filling the full screen via flex: 1.
Ensure 'Admin Dashboard' is distinct but uses the same underlying utility layout components as Settings for managing users, categories, and expenses.
